Name: Abhinay Khalatkar
Canonical: https://abhinaykhalatkar.de/en/
Current Positioning: Full-Stack Software Developer (4+ years of professional experience in Germany)

Professional Summary:
Abhinay Khalatkar is a full-stack developer based in Geilenkirchen, Germany. In his current agency role he is the sole engineer on his client projects: once a design is approved, everything from architecture to go-live and maintenance is his — React/TypeScript and Craft CMS implementation, database design, security hardening, technical SEO, and deployment. Outside work he builds and operates Doordarshi Newsroom, an autonomous English/German AI newsroom running on self-hosted hardware. He is open to Full-Stack, Frontend, and Software Engineer roles in NRW and remote Germany.

Core Expertise:
- Frontend: React 18, Next.js, TypeScript (strict), Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, SCSS, Bootstrap, MUI
- Backend & APIs: PHP 8, Node.js, GraphQL, REST, Craft Commerce, Yii2 modules, Twig, Server-Sent Events
- CMS & Data: Craft CMS 5 (headless & templated), PIMCORE, MySQL, Firebase
- Testing & Quality: Jest, Cypress E2E, pytest, TDD, regression fixtures, pre-push quality gates
- DevOps & Security: Git, Docker, CI/CD, Apache hardening (.htaccess, CSP, CSRF), Linux administration, rsync deployments, Hetzner, AWS
- AI & LLM Engineering: LLM orchestration and routing (Ollama, local + cloud models), multi-agent pipelines, schema-validated model output
- Practices: system design, performance optimization (SSR/CSR), technical SEO, GDPR-by-design development, release management

Case Studies (client work anonymized; all numbers are real):
- Doordarshi Newsroom — Autonomous Bilingual AI Newsroom (personal project, in production since 2025):
  Eight-stage nightly pipeline (intake → claim verification → editorial standards → growth → original writing → media → EU/DE compliance → human approval gate) on a self-hosted multi-agent control plane with Unix-socket orchestration, schema-validated JSON contracts, and local-first LLM routing. ~100 verified bilingual articles/month at €5–8/month total operating cost; nothing publishes without human approval.
- Hybrid Headless E-Commerce Platform (for an industrial manufacturer):
  Craft CMS 5 / PHP 8.2 backend server-rendering the SEO-critical document head, React 18 + strict TypeScript SPA, zero-credential same-origin GraphQL proxy. Organic visitors grew from ~1,000 to ~6,000/month after the technical SEO rebuild; search impressions from ~64,000 to ~105,000. 91 Jest test files and 23 Cypress E2E specs.
- Security-First Deployment Console (internal agency tool):
  Framework-free PHP 8 + vanilla JS with one dependency. SSE build streaming to an in-browser terminal, temp-release builds promoted via rsync on success, 90-second action-bound run tokens, 'self'-only CSP. New client projects reach deploy-ready in one day.
- Rental & Commerce Platform + Live CMS Migration (for an equipment rental and sales company):
  German-language Craft CMS 5 / Twig platform with Craft Commerce repurposed as a rental-inquiry engine and a 30-module page builder (47 entry types, 103 fields). In-place Craft CMS 4→5 migration of the live, order-taking database with zero data loss — 153 migrations rehearsed on a production replica, staged go-live runbook with per-stage rollbacks.
